content: स्फुरणम् [स्फुर्-ल्युट्] .²1 Throbbing, quivering, trembling (in general). .²2 Throbbing or quivering of certain parts of the body (indicating good or bad luck). .²3 Breaking forth, arising, starting into view. .²4 Gleaming, flashing, glittering, shining, twinkling. .²5 Flashing on the mind, crossing the memory. .²6 Expansion, manifestation.
